title: Extreme Heat Disrupts July 4 Celebrations, Renewing Calls for Fossil Fuel Independence
description: A dangerous, record-breaking heatwave across the Central and Eastern US has forced the cancellation of several July 4 events, highlighting the growing impact of the climate crisis on national life. Scientists attribute the severity of the heat to global warming from fossil fuel use, with measurements like Wet Bulb Global Temperature reaching dangerous levels. Climate advocates stress that the event serves as a stark metaphor for the nation's vulnerability and the urgent need to transition to clean energy. Meanwhile, a climate activism group was removed from a related parade, underscoring tensions around public messaging on the emergency. The heatwave, described as virtually impossible in a pre-industrial climate, brings dangerous humidity and sets temperature records. Experts warn such extremes will worsen without rapid decarbonization, linking the crisis to policy choices and the continued fossil fuel subsidies that dwarf support for renewables.
